_howTo: Project review-seat settings (card 84). Extends the platform flavor in review-seat-provider.mjs; set only what differs. review.seatProvider.<correctness|security> = claude | agy | shadow. Switching a seat from shadow to agy is an operator settings flip after the shadow agreement report (node scripts/lib/review-shadow-agreement.mjs --report) shows enough agreement. advisorySeats.agyCorrectness seats an advisory agy juror that never blocks.
